2026.format_details: 48 teams; twelve groups of four, then a round of 32, round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match and final (104 matches)
2026.edition_notes: Expanded 48-team finals format introduced for 2026. The 48-team finals roster is not independently verified here; no fixture total is asserted.

AFC.format: third round: three groups of six; top two qualify; fourth round and a fifth-round decider allocate the remaining direct place and the play-off place

evidence.note: FIFA: AFC has eight direct spots plus one Play-Off Tournament place.

CAF.format: nine groups; group winners qualify; the best runners-up contest a CAF play-off for the inter-confederation route

evidence.note: FIFA: CAF has nine direct spots plus one Play-Off Tournament place.

CONCACAF.format: hosts Canada, Mexico and the United States qualified automatically; three final-round group winners qualify; two further teams enter the Play-Off Tournament

evidence.note: FIFA: two Concacaf teams enter the Play-Off Tournament; Concacaf holds six direct places including the three hosts.

CONMEBOL.format: single ten-team double round robin; top six qualify, seventh enters the Play-Off Tournament

evidence.note: FIFA: CONMEBOL has six direct spots plus one Play-Off Tournament place.

OFC.format: OFC qualifying tournament; winner qualifies directly, runner-up enters the Play-Off Tournament

evidence.note: FIFA: OFC holds one direct place and one Play-Off Tournament place.

UEFA.format: twelve groups; group winners qualify; the four remaining places are decided by the European play-offs among the group runners-up

evidence.note: FIFA: UEFA holds sixteen places.

qualification.results_note: Per-confederation group tables, match results and the final 48-team list are not enumerated here; the finals participants are recorded on the edition participant list once verified.

evidence.note: FIFA 2026 World Cup qualification: expanded 48-team allocation, six confederation allocations and the six-team inter-confederation Play-Off Tournament for two places.
